💡 Why the Personal Plan?​

For months, UModeler X has been available under our Pro and Enterprise tiers – supporting professional teams with a full suite of modeling, rigging, and painting tools inside Unity.

But we’ve heard you – many creators want access to the same power and workflow at a more accessible price.

So here it is: UModeler X Personal License.

  • ✅ Full access to core 3D editing tools
  • ✅ Ongoing feature updates
  • ✅ Early access to new tools
  • ✅ PFL (Perpetual Fallback License) included
  • ✅ Usage limited only by scale – not by creativity
💬 Usage Eligibility

The Personal License is only available to individuals or teams whose total revenue or funding was under $200,000 USD in the past 12 months.
If your organization exceeds this threshold, we recommend the Pro or Enterprise plans instead.

👉 Remember: Personal License is only available to users or teams with < $200K revenue/funding in the past 12 months.

item.title: UModeler X Pro Release and Q1 2025 Update
item.description: Introducing the UModeler X Pro license, free School license, and the key updates made during the first quarter of 2025.
item.content:encoded:
UModeler X Pro Release and Q1 2025 Update

UModeler X, the innovative 3D content creation tool for Unity, proudly introduces its Pro License. Equipped with powerful modeling features, advanced tools for professionals, and access to a premium 3D template library valued at over USD 700, the Pro license is designed to empower both individual creators and teams.

This blog post outlines the full details of the UModeler X Pro license, its pricing, direction for the existing Plus version, the free School license for educators and students, our release roadmap, evangelist activities, and a summary of the major updates completed during Q1 2025.

UModeler X Pro License: Advanced Modeling for Professionals​

UModeler X Pro is a premium license crafted for advanced users and creative teams. It delivers both high efficiency and precision in modeling workflows.

Pricing​

  • Monthly subscription: USD 28/month USD 20/month
  • Annual subscription: USD 280/year USD 199/year
  • Visit the official UModeler website for more details.

Features​

  • Includes all features from UModeler X Plus
  • 1st wave of exclusive Pro features:
    • Curve Mesh Component: For creating organic and curved 3d meshes
    • Text Tool: Generate 3D text meshes
    • Quadify Tool: Convert triangle-based meshes to quad-based meshes
    • Edge Constraints: Allow vertices or edges to move along connected edges while preserving the original shape
    • Isolation Selection Tool: Select specific areas easily

Continuous Feature Updates​

  • Pro users will receive regular updates with newly developed advanced features, many of which are released in beta for early access.

USD 700 Worth of 3D Template Library Included​

  • Unlimited access to premium 3D assets sold individually on the Unity Asset Store
  • All assets are provided as UModeler X prefabs, ready to be edited and used directly within Unity
  • Learn more on the Template Page

UModeler X Plus License​

UModeler X Plus has been a robust modeling toolset used by many creators, offering a comprehensive feature set with long-term support.

Pricing​

  • Lifetime license
  • For individuals and teams with an annual revenue under $200,000
  • Learn more at the UModeler X Plus page on the Unity Asset Store

Key Features​

  • Essential 3D Modeling tools
  • Modifiers
  • UV editor
  • Rigging tools
  • Hotspot texturing system
  • 2D/3D Painting
  • SketchUp-style modeling tools and more

Future Direction and Relationship with Pro​

UModeler X Plus shares the same codebase as Pro. In other words, Pro is an extended version built on top of Plus — it includes all the features of Plus along with advanced capabilities.

✅ All Plus features will continue to receive updates at the same pace and quality as Pro.

✨ Plus will continue to serve as a comprehensive modeling solution focused on stability and long-term maintenance.

🔁 Rather than adding new features, we will prioritize strengthening the stability and maintaining the functionality that has already been implemented.

If you're using Plus, rest assured — it will remain fully supported and your tools will continue to improve.

School License: Free for Students and Educators​

To support creative education, UModeler X offers a free School license to students and educators around the world.

Eligibility​

  • Students and faculty at elementary, middle, high schools, and universities

How to Apply​

  • Sign up using your school domain email
  • Visit the School License Application Page

Conditions​

  • For non-commercial use only, such as education, learning, and assignments

📅 Release Roadmap​

DateMilestone
2025.03.24Pro teaser site launch
2025.03.31Free trial version of Pro released
2025.04.07Official paid Pro license launch

Try out Pro with the free trial before committing to the full version!

Evangelist: 'Indie Game Hustle'​

YouTuber 'Indie Game Hustle', who has been creating helpful tutorial content using UModeler X, officially joined us as a UModeler X Evangelist in February 2024.

His tutorials are beginner-friendly yet packed with insights, bridging the gap between product features and real-world usage. He will continue to expand the community and offer useful resources going forward.

  • Featured Tutorials

👉 View the full playlist

Q1 2025 Update Highlights​

During the first quarter of 2025, UModeler X received 12 major updates (v1.0.8 ~ v1.0.19). Here are the highlights:

SketchUp-Style Modeling Improvements​

  • Parallel Tool, Arc Tool added
  • XY-axis snapping implemented in the Polyline Tool
  • Over 90% feature parity achieved compared to the classic UModeler
  • SketchUp-style tools are now stable and ready for production use

Learn more about SketchUp-style modeling
Watch the Arc Tool demo

  • Group Filter feature for precise painting control
  • Smoothing Sharp Edge for cleaner and softer edge rendering

Favorites Tool Group​

  • Organize your most-used tools into a personal favorites group
  • Default setup includes SketchUp-style tools for beginner-friendly modeling

Beta Feature Tags​

The green potion icon indicates that a tool is currently in beta. Beta tools have completed internal implementation and basic testing, and are now available for public use. However, they may still require improvements in terms of stability and polish. As such, some features of these tools might not behave as expected. Currently, tools like the SketchUp-style modeling tools, the Pro Text Tool, and the Curve Mesh Editor are marked as beta. These tools are under active development and will continue to be refined until they are production-ready.

Website & Manual Updates​

Alongside the Pro launch, we've redesigned our website and documentation for better usability.

  • Official Website

    • unity.umodeler.com

  • New Navigation Sections

    • Template Menu: Overview of all template assets
    • Support Menu: FAQs, troubleshooting, tips and more

Final Words​

UModeler X continues its mission to make 3D content creation more accessible for solo creators and more powerful for professionals.

With the launch of Pro, ongoing updates, community engagement, and educational support, UModeler X is evolving into a comprehensive modeling solution for Unity.

Thank you for being on this journey with us.
Let's keep building amazing things together!

item.title: UModeler X 2025 New Year Update
item.description: Start the new year with exciting updates to UModeler X Plus! Discover new features including improved toolbar settings, enhanced Mirror Object tool, automatic rigging structure setup, and Element ID Selector. Plus, join our special VRChat world design contest and check out our new asset releases in the Unity Asset Store.
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone! Welcome to 2025! Today, we're excited to share the latest updates to UModeler X.

Enhanced UModeler X Plus Features​

This update introduces several new features designed to boost your productivity. Notable additions to the Unity toolbar include two new popup windows: UMX Display Settings and UMX Snap Settings. These windows eliminate the need to navigate through Preferences' options to adjust display and snap settings during your workflow!

For those who love symmetrical modeling, we've enhanced the Mirror Object tool with a preview feature that shows the mirrored parts before creation, making symmetrical modeling more intuitive and efficient.

Character artists will appreciate our new Create Root Bone Structure feature, which automatically generates animation root bones and geometry object hierarchies for rigging. Say goodbye to complex manual setup before rigging!

We're also introducing the Element ID Selector, a powerful troubleshooting tool that visually displays IDs for vertices, edges, and faces, helping you quickly identify and resolve modeling issues.

Element ID Selector

Go to Documentation

Repetitive tasks just got easier with our new repeat function - simply press the `;` key to repeat your last action. This works with various tools including Bridge, Duplicate, Eraser, and Bevel.

Repeat Function

Go to Documentation

Additionally, we've renamed the Line tool to Knife tool and moved it to the Add group. The Drawing mode now features a new Polyline tool, which is continuously being improved!

Special Announcement for VRChat Users!​

We're launching an exciting VRChat world creation contest in collaboration with the Korean World Creators Hub and AbiFair! Create your unique VRChat world or object around the theme "Cozy Haven" for a chance to win a Meta Quest 3S! The contest runs from December 29, 2024, to January 29, 2025, with winners announced on February 5th. Find all the details at the link below:

UMake: VR Design Contest

Create a VRChat world and get a chance to win a Meta Quest 3S!

Apply Now

One of the Top New Assets of 2024 🏆​

UModeler X Plus has been selected as one of the top assets of 2024 on the Unity Asset Store. With practical features that allow 3D modeling directly within Unity, it has gained popularity among many developers. If you’re looking to enhance your workflow quickly and efficiently, check out UModeler X Plus.

User Showcase​

We're proud to highlight some amazing projects created with our tools. The third-person action platformer 'LUSTBORN' has gained attention for its unique character and environment design.

LUSTBORN

Shoot, jump, and navigate your way through a twisted realm of lust and depravity in this third-person action platformer where you play as the buxom Mia Madden... the last LUSTBORN.

Check in Steam

We were also impressed by a user who recreated an Artstation artwork using our tool, showcasing the capabilities of UModeler X.

New Asset Releases​

We're excited to announce two new 3D assets created with UModeler X on the Unity Asset Store: Warm Dream Room, a cozy space designed for VRChat, and Sunset Train, featuring warm, nostalgic aesthetics.

Warm Dream Room (UModeler X)

Check in Asset Store

Sunset Train (UModeler X)

Check in Asset Store

Pro License​

UModeler X Plus introduces over 20 new features compared to the Basic version. Moving forward, Plus will focus on stability improvements and performance optimization rather than new feature additions.

The upcoming Pro license will include all Plus features while continuously adding new functionality. Pro will be offered as a subscription model to ensure sustainable company operations and stable development of UModeler X. This model will enable us to provide regular updates, new feature development, and enhanced technical support.

Get the lastest news of UModeler X Pro

Subscribe Newsletter

Thank you for your continued support of UModeler X. Best regards!

item.title: UModeler X Plus 1.0 Release Date Announcement
item.description: UModeler X Plus 1.0 official version will be released on November 20th, featuring enhanced modeling tools, Humonoid Avatar support, and improved UI systems. While some SketchUp-style modeling features will be gradually implemented post-release, new features like Normal Painting compensate for this adjustment.
item.content:encoded:
Hello UModeler X Plus users,

We are excited to announce that UModeler X Plus 1.0 official version will be released on November 20th. Since the Early Bird version release in September, our team has been working diligently to prepare for the official version.

However, we need to share one piece of news that might disappoint you. The SketchUp-style modeling features we promised in September won't be fully implemented by the 20th. Implementing these features perfectly in the new UModeler X architecture has presented more technical challenges than anticipated. We plan to enhance this functionality through continuous updates after the 1.0 release.

Specifically, the Line tool will be moved to the Add group and renamed to Knife tool to better reflect its polygon-cutting functionality. Additionally, a new Poly Line tool will be added to the Drawing group to support SketchUp-style modeling. As for Hotspot texturing, we will first provide it at the existing UModeler level and implement additional features gradually after the release.

To compensate for these adjustments, we have prepared several new features:

  • Normal Painting (released in October)
  • Humanoid Avatar support
  • Enhanced Display/Debug/Snap Settings UI
  • Separate Parts Tool
  • Offline use available

We are confident these new features will significantly improve your 3D content creation workflow.

We are prioritizing the development of SketchUp-style modeling and Hotspot texturing, aiming to complete them within this year. We will regularly share development progress updates with you.

Here are the key features included in UModeler X Plus 1.0:

  1. SketchUp Style Modeling (including PushPull tool) ver 0.7
  2. Hotspot Texturing Tool
  3. Follow Tool
  4. Array Modifier and Tools
  5. Normal Painting
  6. .OBJ, .STL, .PLY Exporter
  7. Humanoid Avatar support
  8. Multi UV support
  9. Scene saving support for UModeler X 3D model data
  10. Enhanced Debug, Display Settings UI
  11. World and Increment options added to Snap Panel window
  12. Separate Parts Tool
  13. Side Stair Tool
  14. Enhanced Edge Eraser Tool
  15. Offline use available

Post-1.0 UModeler X Plus Roadmap in 2024

  • SketchUp Style Modeling ver 1.0
    • Supports for connecting outer polygons with inner holes.
    • Enhance the stability.
    • and more.
  • Additional Hotspot Texturing features
    • Trim sheet
    • Group-based hotspots
  • Improved Pivot Gizmo system

One more thing—the Plus version will not participate in the Black Friday sale, and the early bird pricing will end then.

We look forward to bringing you the official release news on November 20th.

Thank you for your continued support.
item.author: Jaesik.H@umodeler.com (Jaesik Hwang)

item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to share some thrilling updates about UModeler from October 2024 with our community.

Unite 2024 Participation​

UModeler participated as a sponsor at Unite 2024 (September 18-20, 2023), drawing significant attention from developers worldwide. Notably, we received exceptional interest not only from game developers but also from university educators and students, highlighting how in-Unity 3D modeling capabilities can significantly lower the barriers to education and learning.

UModeler X Plus Early Bird Reaches #1 in Popularity​

A remarkable achievement was the 'UModeler X Plus Early Bird' version reaching #1 in overall popularity on the Unity Asset Store just two days after its release on September 14th. This incredible success demonstrates developers' high expectations and trust in UModeler X Plus.

Continuous Evolution: 7 Significant Updates​

UModeler X Plus Early Bird has undergone remarkable development through seven updates, from 0.91.1 to 0.92.0. Let's look at the key updates.

Core New Features​

  • Align Tool: Precisely align model vertices according to various criteria

  • Normal Painting Tool: Advanced functionality for converting height maps to normal maps

Usability Improvements​

  • Enhanced Tablet Support: Automatic brush opacity and size adjustment based on pressure sensitivity
  • Clear Unused Assets: Efficient scene data cleanup
  • Primitive Shapes: Automatic object naming functionality
  • Vertex Position Editor: Precise position editing in local/world coordinate systems

Performance and Stability​

  • Improved compatibility with Unity 6.0+
  • Multi-material handling optimization
  • Enhanced UV and normal calculation accuracy
  • Various bug fixes and performance improvements

For more detailed information, please check the UModeler X Plus Release Notes.

UModeler X Plus 1.0​

UModeler X Plus 1.0's official release is scheduled for Wednesday, November 20th. As previewed in September, it will feature significantly upgraded capabilities.

Enhanced Modeling System​

  • Upgraded SketchUp Style Modeling: Continuous improvements for intuitive modeling workflow
  • Follow Tool: Enhanced power with progressive generation capabilities added to the existing robust Follow tool
  • Hotspot Texturing: Improved UI/UX and trim sheet support for enhanced texturing experience

System Improvements​

  • Enhanced Save System: Simultaneous .asset and .unity scene file saving for lighter project management
  • Humanoid Avatar Support: Complete Humanoid Avatar support in rigging mode for streamlined animation application

User-Centric License Policy Improvements​

After careful consideration of user feedback, UModeler has enhanced its licensing policy:

Basic Version​

  • Free for both commercial and non-commercial use
  • Updates focused on major bug fixes

Plus Version (After 1.0 Release)​

item.content:encoded:
Hello,

As we approach the end of July, we're here with a new blog post. Over the past month, there have been many updates not only in development but also in our business model. In this blog post, we will share these updates with you.

UModeler X License Model​

Since last September, UModeler X has received various feedback from approximately 4,200 users during the beta testing phase, making it a more powerful and stable tool. Finally, the licensing model for UModeler X has been somewhat finalized. Even after the new licensing model is applied, the various modeling, rigging, painting, and AI texturing tools provided in the existing beta version will continue to be available for free with the Basic license.

The Plus License includes all the features of the Basic license, along with the core features and major tools of UModeler, aiming to fully replace the original UModeler. Existing UModeler users will have the benefit of purchasing the Plus license at an upgrade price. This Plus license is scheduled to be released as an early bird version in September 2024, with the official version launching on the Unity Asset Store in November 2024.

The Pro and Team licenses, which will be subscription-based, are set to be unveiled early next year. These licenses will not only include all the features of the Plus license but also provide the fastest access to the latest features of UModeler X.

For more information on the UModeler X license, please refer to the FAQ page below.

UModeler X License Model

Go to

Technical Roadmap​

Along with the confirmation of the licensing model, the technical roadmap has also been somewhat defined.

All upcoming license models will include the Texture Parameter Tool and Face Color Tool currently available in the Beta version.

The Plus license will feature the core functions of the original UModeler, including Sketch-Based Modeling, Hotspot Texturing, Array Tool, Follow Tool, and more.

The Pro and Team licenses will offer advanced features to enhance 3D content creation, such as AI Texturing 2.0, Curve Editor, and Pelt Unwrap. Additionally, new features will be continually added.

The technical roadmap until the first quarter of 2025 is as follows. Please note that the following list of features may be subject to change depending on circumstances.

  • Technical Roadmap (July 2024 - March 2025)
    • July 2024 - Beta Version
      • Texture Parameter Tool
      • Face Color Tool
    • September 2024 - Plus License Early Bird Version
      • Array Tool (similar to Clone Tool in UModeler)
      • Export Tool (supports .OBJ, .STL, .PLY)
      • PushPull Tool
      • Sketch-based Modeling
    • November 2024 - Plus License Official Version
      • Follow Tool
      • Hotspot Texturing
      • Multi-channel UV Editing
      • And more
    • February 2025 - Pro, Team Licenses
      • AI Texturing 2.0
      • Curve Editor
      • Pelt Unwrap
      • Voxel Editor
      • Plan Editor
      • And more

Update News​

We would like to share the major updates of UModeler X from the past month.

From version 0.19.20 to 0.19.24, various features have been added to assist in level design.

New Features in the Preference Window​

  • Create As Static Object: This option allows UModelerX Objects to be created as Static by default.
  • Static Option: This option sets the Static options for UModelerX Objects when the Create As Static Object option is enabled.
  • Always Enable Grid Snap: This option allows the Grid Snapping feature to always be enabled when a UModelerX Object is selected.
  • Create Under Root: This option allows UModelerX Objects to be created without a parent object.

New Object Creation in Basic Shape Tool​

Allows new basic shapes to be created as separate objects.

Snap Panel Window​

Register Grid Snap and Rotate Snap sizes in advance and easily select the desired snap size.

Many other aspects have been improved. For more detailed update news, please refer to the release notes in the online manual.

item.title: Low Poly Tutorials, Zepeto Guidebook, UModeler X Enhancements, and FIA Game Jam Results
item.description: In this June update, we cover the completion of the Low Poly tutorial series, the release of the Zepeto item guidebook, and recent enhancements in UModeler X. We also share the exciting results from the UModeler X game jam held with FIA.
item.content:encoded:
Hello, UModeler X Users!

In this June blog, we bring you various exciting news. From the completion of the Low Poly tutorial series and the release of the Zepeto item guidebook to the latest updates in UModeler X and the results of the game jam held with FIA, there's plenty to catch up on. Check out the latest developments and community activities with UModeler X!

Completion of the Low Poly Tutorial Series​

The Low Poly tutorial series for beginners is finally complete! With the newly added "Low Poly Isometric Room" tutorial, we now have a comprehensive learning course that covers everything from the basics of 3D modeling to practical projects for beginners.

This tutorial series is designed to be easy to follow, even for beginners, and includes the following courses:

  • Basic Tutorial: Modeling, Rigging, and Painting Modes
  • Basic Tutorial: UV Editor Guide
  • Low Poly Table and Chair Tutorial Guide
  • Low Poly Tower Tutorial Guide
  • Low Poly Building Tutorial Guide
  • New! Low Poly Isometric Room Tutorial
  • Final Tutorial: Synty Studio Assets and Mixamo Animation Integration Guide

You can check out the tutorials in order from the page below.

Basics Tutorial

This tutorial is designed for beginners to give you an overview of the features and basic usage of UModeler X.

Learn

Each tutorial is structured in a step-by-step manner, allowing users to practice through real projects. The newly added "Low Poly Isometric Room" tutorial, in particular, provides detailed instructions on creating an isometric style room, helping you enhance your 3D modeling skills.

All tutorial videos can be found on the UModeler X manual page. Each video is provided with friendly explanations, making it easy for beginners to understand and follow along.

We hope this tutorial series will be greatly helpful in your 3D modeling journey with UModeler X, and we look forward to bringing you even better content and features in the future.


Release of the Zepeto Item Guidebook​

We are excited to introduce the newly released Zepeto Item Creation Guidebook. This guidebook covers everything from the basics to advanced applications, enabling even those who are not familiar with Unity to create Zepeto items easily using UModeler X.

This guidebook is extremely useful for beginners who are creating Zepeto items for the first time, as well as for intermediate and advanced users who want to create items more conveniently.

The guidebook includes the following contents:

  • Chapter 1 - Getting Started with UModeler X: Introduction to essential software and installation process.
  • Chapter 2 - Exploring the UModeler X Interface: Navigating the interface and utilizing tools.
  • Chapter 3 - Basic Modeling: Basic elements and functions of 3D modeling.
  • Chapter 4 - Modeling Application: Applying modeling in actual projects.
  • Chapter 5 - UV Mapping, Texturing, and Painting: Techniques for UV mapping and texturing.
  • Chapter 6 - Rigging: Bringing models to life through rigging processes.
  • Chapter 7.1 - Masking: Importance and effective creation and application of masks.
  • Chapter 7.2 - Upload: How to upload completed items to Zepeto Studio.

Zepeto Item Guidebook

Go to

The video below is the tutorial video for Chapter 4, one of the seven videos created for the Zepeto Item Creation Guidebook.


Enjoy the process of creating Zepeto items with UModeler X through this guidebook.

UModeler X Update News​

Over the past month, UModeler X has had three updates: 0.19.17, 0.19.18, and 0.19.19. These updates bring various improvements that make your 3D modeling experience more convenient and efficient.

Key updates include:

  • Improved Vertex/Edge Picking: The mouse cursor now highlights and allows selection when it is near edges and vertices, making element editing much easier.
  • Distance Property Addition: You can now input element distances numerically, enabling more precise work.
  • Improved Bridge Tool: The Bridge tool has been enhanced to easily fill holes.
  • Improved UModelerize: Addition of Hierarchically option. Changing the setting for Merge Vertices option to be adjustable in the Preference window.
  • Shortcut Addition for Backface Select in Vertex/Edge/Face Tool: This allows for faster and more efficient work.

For more details, please refer to the release notes.

UModeler X Release Notes

Go to

We hope these updates will enhance your 3D modeling experience with UModeler X. We will continue to meet your expectations with ongoing improvements and updates.

Results of the UModeler X Game Jam with FIA​

The Future Inspire Jam #5, held this month, has concluded successfully. This game jam saw many creative game projects using UModeler X, drawing significant attention. Here are the winning entries and major news from the jam.

1st Place: "Without a Way Out" by @Alex Santos​

This game made impressive use of UModeler's tools to create simple yet consistent models with more detail than other entries, earning high praise from the judges and taking the top spot.

2nd Place: "Without-Time" by D.P.L.D.S​

This game skillfully implemented a time mechanic, particularly a rewind skill, to create a short and sweet game, securing the second place with its unique idea and neat execution.

3rd Place: "Without Movement" by @ojas biswas 123​

This game innovatively changed the gameplay mechanics to fit the theme perfectly, maintaining a consistent theme and leaving a strong impression on the judges.

Thank you to everyone who participated, and we look forward to your continued interest and participation!

item.content:encoded:
Hello UModeler X users! Today, we're excited to share some thrilling and valuable updates with you. In this blog post, we'll cover the latest news, updates, and our achievements with UModeler X.

UModeler X Game Jam Announcement!​

First, let's talk about the UModeler X Game Jam. This game jam, hosted in collaboration with Future Inspire Academy (FIA), focuses on creating 3D games using Unity. FIA is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing game development education in a fun and flexible manner. They offer Unity challenges, game creation tasks, mentoring, and a gamified leaderboard to support developers worldwide.

We sponsor this game jam. Participants will use UModeler X's rigging, painting, AI texturing, and modeling features to develop creative games. All participants must submit their projects on GitHub, with primary assets created using UModeler X. For detailed rules and participation, check the links below.

  • UModeler X Game Jam Site
  • FIA Discord Server

UModeler X Update News​

Over the past month we released six updates from version 0.19.11 to 0.19.16. Here are some of the key updates:

  • Weight Mirror Tool Addition

    This tool allows you to easily copy the weight values of vertices from one side to the symmetric counterpart in symmetric objects, significantly improving efficiency.

  • Standard Brush Tool Improvement

    You can now push in the opposite direction of the surface normal by holding the Ctrl key while brushing. Additionally, you can adjust the brush size by holding the Shift key and moving the mouse up and down.

  • Auto Generate Mesh Collider Addition

    The Auto Generate Mesh Collider property has been added to the Preferences window and the Local Settings tool of UModeler X objects. This feature allows new objects to automatically reflect the mesh editing, enhancing level design convenience.

UModeler X and UModeler in VRChat Asset Picks​

We're proud to announce that UModeler and UModeler X have been selected as valuable assets for VRChat content creation on the globally popular VR metaverse platform VRChat. Now, VRChat creators can use UModeler and UModeler X to craft even more impressive content.

  • VRChat Picks in the Unity Asset Store

Little Kitty Big City Game Release​

Finally, we're thrilled to announce the release of the game Little Kitty Big City, developed using the predecessor of UModeler X, UModeler. This game is now available on Steam, XBox and Nintendo Switch, and it has been well-received by gamers worldwide. This success story underscores the excellence of UModeler. Enjoy enhanced productivity with UModeler and UModeler X.

  • XBox
  • Steam
  • Nintendo Switch

These are the latest updates from UModeler X. We hope you continue to enjoy creating with UModeler X. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting news!

item.title: Enhancements to the Learning Process for Beginners and the Runtime VR Project and more
item.description: New tutorial videos for beginners have been added, and the overall learning process has been enhanced. Also, check out the news about the VR experiment project created with UModeler X.
item.content:encoded:
Enhancements to the UModeler X Tutorial Courses for Beginners​

The tutorial course for beginners in UModeler X has been newly strengthened, making it easy for anyone to enter the world of 3D modeling. Now, after learning the basics of modeling, rigging, and painting, you can proceed with practice-like exercises through low poly modeling. The newly added 'Lowpoly Table and Chair' and 'Lowpoly Tower' tutorial videos will be an excellent next step for those who have completed the basic education.


Beginners are recommended to gradually learn the various features of UModeler X according to the tutorial course below. Each tutorial can be easily accessed through the provided links.

  1. Basic Tutorials
    • Learn the basics of modeling, rigging, and painting.
    • You can master the basics of UV editing.
    • Link: Basic Tutorials
  2. Low Poly Tutorials
    • Start with a simple table and chair and move on to towers and buildings.
    • A low poly student room production tutorial will also be added soon.
    • Link: Low Poly Tutorials
  3. Synty Studios and Mixamo
    • Apply animations to your finished models.
    • Link: Synty Studios and Mixamo

This systematic tutorial course is designed to allow users who are new to UModeler X to learn step-by-step, from the basics to practical application. This tutorial will be a good guide on your journey to creating your own creations.

UModeler X VR Prototype Project​

The UModeler X team, led by lead developer Kim Se-yong, conducted an innovative internal project called 'VR BlackSmith' to deeply explore the potential of the release version. This project aimed to integrate ancient blacksmith techniques into a modern VR environment. It was about implementing the traditional method of forging iron and making tools in a VR setting using UModeler X's advanced modeling technology.

The project was carried out by dedicating 20% of Kim Se-yong's working hours from January to March. During this time, the focus was on meticulously testing and improving the modeling functionality of UModeler X and the runtime performance of the Boolean tool. These efforts confirmed that UModeler X could perform excellently in real-time environments.

During the development process, the flexibility and powerful modeling capabilities of UModeler X were deeply explored for VR content creation. As a result, the 'VR BlackSmith' project successfully developed a prototype that allows users to experience blacksmith techniques and create tools within the VR environment using UModeler X's features.

The project's achievements, despite being a prototype version, are demonstrated in a demo video, showcasing the core functionalities of UModeler X and proving its potential. The experiences and insights gained from this project will have a significant impact on the future development direction of UModeler X.


UModeler X Updates Over the Last Month​

The updates to UModeler X over the last month have focused on improvements to modeling and painting modes, as well as performance enhancements for the UV editor and 3D painting. Version 0.19.6 addressed GPU crash issues, and versions 0.19.8 and 0.19.9 fixed various bugs to enhance the usability of modeling tools. Notably, the functionality of the bevel tool and slice cut tool was improved, and the accuracy of Boolean operations was enhanced, significantly improving the user experience. Additionally, issues with shortcuts in rigging and painting modes were resolved, increasing stability.

For more detailed update information, please refer to UModeler X's release notes.

UModeler X is moving towards a more stable version based on issues reported by you through the UModeler Discord server and email.

URP/HDRP Issue Fixes and Improvements​

With the UModeler X 0.19.4 update, we have resolved most of the issues that arose with URP and HDRP. For example, the issue where hidden elements were selected when Camera Based Select was activated, and issues that occurred in modeling/rigging/painting modes when using tools with brushes, have been fixed.

Low-Poly Building Tutorial Released​

We released a tutorial video on making low-poly buildings. A user's request recently made us realize that we had not created demos or videos related to low-poly due to focusing on showing that UModeler X is capable of high-poly modeling, rigging, and painting. Many indie game developers likely use UModeler X for creating low-poly meshes. So starting with this low-poly building tutorial video, we plan to create various low-poly tutorial videos. I will make time to create and showcase tutorials on mugs, chairs, towers, barrels, etc. If there's a tutorial you would like to see, please suggest it on our Discord server. These tutorials are also easy for me to make quickly using UModeler X, even though I come from a programmer background.

Obtaining a US Patent for 3D Modeling Technology​

UModeler Inc. has obtained a patent in the United States for a "METHOD AND 3D MODELING ENGINE FOR MANAGING MODELING DATA DURING 3D MODELING". This technology covers an efficient method for creating and editing 3D data in a real-time graphics environment. Thanks to this, it has been possible to develop a high-performance 3D modeling solution in the Unity editor using the C# language.

GDC 2024​

We will be attending GDC 2024 in San Francisco from March 20th to 22nd. We're so excited about attending GDC after a long time. If anyone else is going, please contact me via email (contact.support@umodeler.com) or DM on Discord/Facebook. I'll share the news from GDC when we return.

Conclusion​

That's all for this blog update. The various issues and feedback that you share via Discord and email play a significant role in making UModeler X more stable and useful. item.description: This blog post helps you get started with the painting mode.
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone! I'm very happy to introduce our second blog post. Today, we'll talk about the major updates made over the last two months, the newly added painting mode guide, and the backlog we are working on to make UModeler X even more stable.

Major Updates for January and February 2024​

Several useful features were added in January and February this year. Take a look, and if you're still using an older version of UModeler X, I hope you take this opportunity to update to the latest version.

Ruler Feature​

You can easily measure the distance between selected vertices and the length of edges.

Improved Snapping Function​

he Height Snap feature has been added, allowing elements to be aligned based on the direction of movement and the position of the cursor. Additionally, Unity's Grid/Incremental snap functionality has been integrated into the basic shape tools. This improves accuracy and ease of use.

Added View Cut Function​

With the new Slice Cut tool, you can easily slice meshes by creating a virtual plane that matches the camera direction.

Shortcut​

In UModeler X, you can assign shortcuts for all tools using Unity's shortcut manager.

Decimate Modifier​

With the new Decimate modifier, you can reduce the number of polygons in a mesh to efficiently optimize the model.

Commentary Feature​

Check your UModeler X usage status with the new Commentary feature. It provides information on the tools you are using, mouse/keyboard inputs, and Undo/Redo actions.

In addition to these feature additions, many improvements have been made. For more update news, please refer to the UModeler Discord channel.

Painting Mode Guide​

A guide document for users starting with the painting mode has been added to the manual page. It's a very convenient feature that allows you to create or modify textures directly on 3D models. This guide provides useful information on how to start painting mode and how to use textures created in this mode.

Current Ongoing Backlogs​

Based on your feedback, we are working hard to update UModeler X every week. The backlog items scheduled to be addressed in the next 2-3 weeks are as follows.

  • Performance issues when navigating the camera with the mouse in edit mode.
  • Addition of a feature to reset properties in the LoopCut tool.
  • Problems with selecting hidden polygons.
  • Rendering issues when a disabled UModelerXEditableMesh component is reactivated.
  • Unity freezing when saving the scene.
  • Hierarchy problems occurring when umodelerizing multiple meshes.
  • Improvement of painting brush speed.

Conclusion​

We hope your 3D modeling experience improves with UModeler X, and we will always listen to your valuable feedback. Your interest and support are the driving forces behind the development of UModeler X. Please continue to support us.

item.title: Starting the UModeler blog
item.description: This is the first post on UModeler.
item.content:encoded:
Hello! I'm very excited to start a blog like this. I was thinking about what to write for my first blog post, and I decided it would be interesting to talk about why we started developing UModeler X, the process we went through, and how we plan to develop it further, as this is something we haven't had many chances to discuss.

The reason I started developing UModeler X while the existing UModeler was receiving a lot of love from Unity developers is as follows:

  1. To allow for smooth editing of high-poly 3D data within the Unity editor.
  2. To integrate all functions needed for 3D data creation, including modeling, rigging, painting, and sculpting, so that games can be made 100% within Unity.
  3. To lay the groundwork for runtime solution development as well as editor solutions, aiming to develop new products for more 3D creators outside of Unity.
  4. To allow creators to make various contents such as 3D worlds, games, items, and characters with UModeler X, and to support more creators' creative activities with the results produced from here.

UModeler X Development Story​

UModeler X began its full-scale development in mid-2020, facing various technical and planning challenges. We overcame these challenges one by one to reach its current form. I will briefly introduce the development process.

In 2020​

  • In 2020, the initial development focused on implementing an architecture that could quickly update the connectivity information between the elements of a mesh, such as vertices, edges, and faces. Additionally, we concentrated on ensuring that the visualization, selection, and movement of these mesh elements could be handled cleanly and swiftly. The BMesh architecture from Blender provided significant help in implementing this architecture. To verify performance, we conducted basic modeling tests such as element selection and movement using an 800,000 polygon Stanford Dragon mesh. The results confirmed that UModeler X could adequately edit high-poly models within Unity.
  • In addition to this, we introduced a command-based modular approach to increase work efficiency and significantly reduce the data size needed for Undo/Redo operations.
  • We also added the ability to modify the original mesh (Source Mesh) without altering it by introducing modifiers (Modifier). The initial implementation of the Mirror, Subdivide, FFD, Shell, and Push modifiers has made modeling much easier and more efficient.
  • We adopted the OpenSubdiv library to implement a subdivision (Subdivision) tool that directly converts low-quality, low-poly 3D data into high-quality, high-poly 3D data.

In 2021​

  • We introduced the MVVM(Model-View-ViewModel) pattern to separate rendering, data, and actual implementation. Additionally, we upgraded the UI design to make it more sophisticated.
  • We developed a solution that utilizes the GPU to select vertices, edges, and faces of high-poly meshes with high performance.
  • We implemented various modeling-related features belonging to basic shapes (Primitive Shapes), Add, Remove, and Surface groups on top of the new architecture.
  • We also implemented a built-in UV editor to enable UV unwrapping and editing.
  • In the summer of 2021, we were able to create high-end 3D models that the original UModeler could not achieve, fully utilizing the features of UModeler X implemented up to that point.
  • In UV editing, a new unwrapping feature using the LSCM (Least Squares Conformal Maps) algorithm was added, allowing complex meshes to be unfolded into 2D UV coordinates with minimal distortion by following the seams.
  • We finally implemented rigging for character animation. Now, not only can you create a skeleton structure, but you can also import and use an existing skeleton directly. Additionally, we implemented the Weight Transfer feature, which calculates weights based on the weights of another mesh. By fully utilizing the modeling features and rigging implemented up to that point, we were able to successfully create character items for the Zepeto metaverse, thereby verifying the performance of UModeler X.

In 2022​

  • We continuously verified the capabilities of UModeler X by creating a demo that combined a cute character with a 2.5D proportion, made using UModeler X, with a background created using UModeler.
  • Developed a 3D painting mode that allows direct coloring on 3D models with a brush. This supports layers like Photoshop, and each layer can have Paint, Fill, and Sticker properties. 2D painting is also supported, making it possible to create textures in Unity, which was previously cumbersome.
    • 3D Painting Prototype
    • First Version of 3D Painting
  • Conducted more than three alpha tests targeting students learning Unity. Through this, we were able to receive a wide range of feedback and enhance the completeness of UModeler X.
  • In 2022, a lot of time and effort were invested in adding new features, creating a stable and scalable system, and addressing technical debt. As a result, the existing command system, prefab, and tool usage workflows were significantly improved. Continuous testing led to the identification and resolution of many issues. While these improvements may not seem significant externally, they ultimately laid the groundwork for a stronger leap forward.

In 2023​

  • First Closed Beta (March 2023~)
    • Conducted a closed beta for Zepeto creators. Zepeto uses Unity as a development studio for creators.
    • Launched a landing page in January and granted access to users who left their emails on March 29.
    • Although the number of people who actually used UModeler X was not as high as the number who applied, we were able to receive helpful feedback from real Zepeto creators, which greatly aided in improving UModeler X.
    • Improved rigging and export features to accommodate various body types of Zepeto.
    • Opened the Official UModeler X Manual Site, built using the Docusaurus solution.
  • Second Closed Beta (July 2023~)
    • Held an invitation event. Invitations could be received either from someone who was already invited or by applying directly on the website. In retrospect, it might have been better not to conduct this event as part of a viral marketing strategy.
    • Began to inform existing UModeler users about UModeler X. We created a new UModeler X category in the UModeler Discord channel and simultaneously announced the news of UModeler X's second closed beta in communities where Unity developers are active.
    • Released the first demo video.
    • Released tutorial videos to help get started with UModeler X, serving as an excellent guide.
    • Added an auto-rigging feature similar to the Mixamo concept. Setting guide points automatically generates a skeleton for human and quadruped meshes and assigns weights to vertices.
    • Implemented AI texturing in collaboration with the game company nerdystar, working with Stable Diffusion + WebUI. This allows for direct projection of AI-generated images onto 3D models in the scene view, simplifying the cumbersome texture creation process.
  • Open Beta (September 2023~)
    • From this point on, anyone can use UModeler X simply by signing up.
    • Released the second demo video.
  • Launched UModeler X on the Unity Asset Store. Now anyone can download UModeler Hub from the Asset Store and use UModeler X.
    • UModeler X with AI-Texturing
  • Opened a course on Unity's Official Online Learning Site (learn.unity.com) for getting started with UModeler X.
    • Getting Started with UModelerX - Unity Learn
  • Created a demo video showcasing the advantages of using UModeler X with Synty Studios' assets in Unity, allowing for direct editing and animation.

In the future​

Our goal with UModeler X is to upgrade the Unity editor, used by over 1.1 million people monthly, into an easier and more convenient tool for creating 3D content. If anyone using the Unity editor can fully unleash their imagination with UModeler X, the world will become more exciting and colorful. To achieve such a world, UModeler X will continue to develop and evolve without cease.

In 2024​

This year, we plan to implement the sketch-based smart modeling that made the original UModeler special, into UModeler X as well. Also, hotspot texturing and the Curve editor are expected to be integrated into UModeler X soon. Additionally, AI Texturing version 2.0 is waiting for you. We are preparing many more features, so you can look forward to them.

Getting Started with UModeler X​

To install UModeler X, you first need to install the Hub from the Unity Asset Store. This Hub is responsible for the installation and updating of UModeler X and allows for the download of other necessary assets. After running the Hub, create an account and log in to install UModeler X.

Once the installation is complete, you can start using it right away by referring to the previously introduced UModeler X online manual.

Community and Support Channels​

If you have any improvements, questions, or issues you'd like to discuss while using UModeler X, try using the UModeler Discord server. You can receive direct feedback from developers or other UModeler X users there. You can also get the latest news about UModeler X on this server. Feel free to inquire through the UModeler Unity Forum or Email.

  • UModeler Discord Server
  • Unity UModeler Forum
  • contact.support@umodeler.com

Resources​

For the latest information, follow UModeler on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram.
